description: This Java class implements the state management for related entities aggregation calculations within the Thingsboard platform, including scheduling reevaluations, handling entity data, and performing aggregation logic.

classes.name: RelatedEntitiesAggregationCalculatedFieldState
classes.description: Manages the state and logic for related entities aggregation calculations, including scheduling, data updates, and aggregation processing.

methods.name: setCtx
methods.description: Initializes context and configuration, including metrics and entity service.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the state, scheduling reevaluation if restored.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cancels scheduled reevaluation tasks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state and timestamps.

methods.name: resetScheduledRefreshTs
methods.description: Resets the timestamp for the last scheduled refresh.

methods.name: getLastScheduledRefreshTs
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last scheduled refresh.

methods.name: updateScheduledRefreshTs
methods.description: Updates the timestamp for the last scheduled refresh.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of calculated field.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates argument values and timestamps.

methods.name: checkRelatedEntities
methods.description: Checks and updates related entities, returning missing entities.

methods.name: findMissingEntities
methods.description: Identifies related entities missing in the current state.

methods.name: findOutdatedEntities
methods.description: Identifies entities that are outdated in the current state.

methods.name: updateEntityData
methods.description: Updates internal data for a fetched entity argument set.

methods.name: cleanupEntityData
methods.description: Removes data related to a specific entity.

methods.name: scheduleReevaluation
methods.description: Schedules a reevaluation task based on deduplication interval.

methods.name: performCalculation
methods.description: Performs aggregation calculation and returns the result.

methods.name: shouldRecalculate
methods.description: Determines if recalculation is needed based on timestamps.

methods.name: getEnforcedDeduplicationIntervalMillis
methods.description: Calculates the effective deduplication interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: prepareInputs
methods.description: Prepares input data for aggregation from arguments.

methods.name: aggregateMetrics
methods.description: Performs aggregation over metrics.

methods.name: aggregateMetric
methods.description: Aggregates a specific metric over inputs.

methods.name: applyAggregation
methods.description: Checks if an entity input passes the filter for aggregation.

methods.name: resolveAggregationInput
methods.description: Resolves the input value for aggregation based on configuration.

methods.name: getArgumentsJson
methods.description: Serializes current arguments and entity info into JSON.

methods.name: checkReadiness
methods.description: Checks if the state is ready for calculation.

methods.name: checkConstraintByDirection
methods.description: Validates relation direction constraints for related entities.
